provenance: Assessment of recorded simulated outcomes; no new inference or human data

hypotheses.question: Conversation captures preferences better than a one-time survey
hypotheses.verdict: Mechanism supported in scripted cases; broader claim untested
hypotheses.evidence: 3/3 changed study targets exactly recovered. Unchanged survey target error: 1 C after the change.
hypotheses.limit: Explicit numeric messages do not measure natural conversational coverage or survey burden.

hypotheses.question: The model notices study, sleep and away routines
hypotheses.verdict: Supported on the synthetic routine holdout
hypotheses.limit: Synthetic schedules; no student routine was observed.

hypotheses.question: Updated preferences lead to more accepted suggestions
hypotheses.verdict: Supported by the assumed acceptance proxy
hypotheses.evidence: Ours minus survey: +4.76 percentage points across the trial; +9.70 after the scripted change.
hypotheses.limit: Acceptance is a simulated occupant rule. Every suggested action applies regardless of acceptance.

hypotheses.question: Energy use falls without lowering comfort
hypotheses.evidence: Versus fixed: fan energy -35.11%; occupied violations +2.38 percentage points.
hypotheses.limit: No human non-inferiority margin or powered field study was conducted.

hypotheses.question: Use less energy without reducing comfort
hypotheses.evidence: Fan energy decreases, but discomfort violations increase by 2.38 percentage points versus fixed.
hypotheses.limit: The lower electricity outcome includes a comfort trade-off.

hypotheses.question: Respond to sleep, study and away routines
hypotheses.evidence: Activity targets persist across context switches; away intervals use fan off; sleeping obeys the configured fan maximum.
hypotheses.limit: The main controller trial uses observed synthetic activity. Learned auto mode is evaluated separately.

hypotheses.question: Use room physics to make better suggestions
hypotheses.verdict: Supported for discomfort under the no-physics ablation
hypotheses.evidence: Ours minus no-physics: occupied violations -16.44 percentage points; fan electricity +145.7 Wh/day.
hypotheses.limit: Lookahead improves modeled comfort at higher energy. This is a joint policy comparison, not a proof of physical accuracy.

hypotheses.question: Improve the room energy performance index
hypotheses.verdict: Supported for the trial-period fan EPI
hypotheses.evidence: Ours 0.1696 versus fixed 0.2613 kWh/m2 over the seven-day period (-35.11%).
hypotheses.limit: Fan-only period EPI excludes lighting, appliances and other building electricity. It is not annual whole-building EPI.

phase_comparison_note: Before and after windows differ in duration and weather. Matched methods share forcing within each seed. These are descriptive synthetic contrasts, not participant statistics.
